infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock DevBox and access your sessions securely.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: DevBox uses speech recognition so you can dictate prompts to your AI coding agent hands-free.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DevBox uses the microphone to capture your voice when using speech-to-text input.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DevBox can attach images from your photo library to messages to your AI coding agent.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DevBox can capture images with your camera and attach them to messages to your AI coding agent.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DevBox uses your local network to connect to self-hosted DevBox servers running on your LAN.
